entities.summary: Elijah Danilo Moore is an American professional football wide receiver for the Philadelphia Eagles of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels and was selected by the New York Jets in the second round of the 2021 NFL draft. He has also played for the Cleveland Browns, Buffalo Bills, and Denver Broncos.
